description: Read the public, append-only log of Countersign stamps: entries after a sequence number, in order, plus the head hash, entry count and public key so you can check signatures yourself. Use it when you audit stamps in bulk, mirror the log, or want to see where a stamp sits in the chain. Free, read-only; private stamps show only a hash of each finding's detail.

after.description: Return entries with a sequence number above this (default 0 = from the first entry)

name: countersign_log
